result.stdout:
efpilot

A smarter CLI for managing Entity Framework Core migrations.

Usage:
  efpilot <command>

Commands:
  init         Initialize EfPilot configuration
  add          Create a migration
  remove       Remove the last migration
  apply        Apply migrations to the database
  update       Apply migrations to the database (alias for apply)
  status       Show applied and pending migrations
  script       Generate a SQL migration script
  bundle       Generate an executable migration bundle
  diff         Preview model changes
  diagnostics  Analyze EF Core migration workflow health

Examples:
  efpilot init
  efpilot add AddLoanCode --profile RateRiskDbContext [--verbose]
  efpilot remove --profile RateRiskDbContext [--force] [--verbose]
  efpilot apply --profile RateRiskDbContext [--to InitialCreate] [--verbose]
  efpilot update --profile RateRiskDbContext [--to InitialCreate] [--verbose]
  efpilot status --profile RateRiskDbContext [--all] [--verbose]
  efpilot script --profile RateRiskDbContext [--idempotent] [--output 
artifacts/raterisk.sql] [--verbose]
  efpilot bundle --profile RateRiskDbContext [--output 
artifacts/raterisk-bundle] [--force] [--target-runtime linux-x64] [--verbose]
  efpilot diff --profile RateRiskDbContext [--verbose]
  efpilot diagnostics [--profile RateRiskDbContext] [--verbose]

Global options:
  --help, -h       Show help
  --version, -v    Show version
